svg.title: What a 1% fee really costs
svg.desc: A line chart of $10,000 growing at 7% a year for 30 years. With no fee it reaches $76,123; with a 1% yearly fee it reaches $57,435. The $18,688 gap is about a quarter of the no-fee result.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
